No, there has not been a deadly stampede at a Durga Puja pandal in Kolkata before 2026. 

The closest prior incident was at Deshapriya Park in 2015, where a massive crowd to view an 88-foot idol caused a near-stampede that injured about 11 people but resulted in no deaths. Contemporary reports confirm no earlier fatal stampedes during Kolkata’s Puja celebrations.

note_tweet.text:
The most recent stampede in West Bengal is the one at Chorbagan Sarbojanin Durga Puja pandal in Kolkata on 17 October 2026, which killed 19 people.

Before that, a non-fatal crowd surge at Deshapriya Park during Durga Puja in 2015 injured around 11 people. The last fatal stampede was on 16 August 1980 at Eden Gardens during a Mohun Bagan-East Bengal football match, which killed 16 fans.
